scope: 原第5项追加：全局页与明确任务上下文/来源/动作分层，content_units真实分类与处理批次说明
web_typecheck: passed independent check before URL fix; final production build includes final source TypeScript check

navigation_rules.fresh_open: Only creation tab; valid explicit run/history URL opens its corresponding view. No automatic paper or output selection.
navigation_rules.views: Still one task context; view tabs open when visited, without introducing independent per-task tab instances.
navigation_rules.global_pages: Creation/history titles belong to those pages; URL carries only view. No task original/side panel/detail errors/source warning/restore controls; global loading errors remain.
navigation_rules.in_memory_context: An explicitly selected valid task can remain in memory for returning to an already visited task tab, but global-page refresh does not restore that task context. Sidebar selection is absent on global pages.
navigation_rules.invalid_selection: Deleted, missing, refreshed-out or run-detail404 contexts clear paper/run/history/record, related view tabs and URL. Other tasks remain available but are never automatically substituted.
navigation_rules.URL_normalization: Shared serializer runs explicitly after the first successful server-list read, and on later valid view/selection changes. A failed initial list read leaves a potentially valid deep link intact.
navigation_rules.draft: Creation component remains mounted; switching views/deleting/refreshing task context does not reset the unsubmitted title/file list. Browser reload retains only already-admitted server tasks, as before.
navigation_rules.actions: Navigation toggle is .t1-nav-toggle in the global brand. Original controls live in .t1-results-actions only for a known task and matching nonblocked source. Batch source follows the selected record child run.
navigation_rules.source_binding: Single result response id/paper/output/records are checked against the exact run; batch binding remains unchanged.

progress_rules.new_content_units: New coverage/SSE uses content_units and completed_content_unit_ids. Raw lines, long-group parts and summary reads cannot advance parent-group counts.
progress_rules.composition: Notes display recorded nine-category totals/completed totals only; missing legacy classification cannot be inferred from 2158 or another overall total. Body passages/figure text/structural units/fragments stay distinct.
progress_rules.legacy: paragraphs retains legacy content-unit totals; source_blocks remains historical lines; no rewrite/reclassification of old runs.
progress_rules.batch_label: 处理批次; Notes explain input-length grouping and multiple model exchanges per batch, which is not a request count.
progress_rules.completion: Existing task completion gates and whole-submission aggregation remain unchanged.

diagnostics.isolated_dev: Owned 30158 Turbopack remained at first compile; first browser navigation/HTTP read timed out. No dev webpack fallback or production restart. Stopped and restored generated files.
diagnostics.candidate_result: 7/8; first normalized empty React selection did not rerun URL effect, leaving stale paper query. Fixed explicit initial normalization via shared serializer; final8/8. Candidate pass count is not final acceptance.

test_limitations: Chromium desktop and 390px emulation, no physical mobile device.
Task create/upload/delete fixture actions were fulfilled inside the browser; no real user task was created/deleted/cancelled.
No new provider call, no medical-quality or speed claim. New input composition is backend-owned; frontend presents supplied counts, not new extraction evidence.
